title: Tidebreakers launch week status
brief: Starlark Games is a week into the launch of Tidebreakers and the studio head wants a status page she can forward to the board. Launch was Monday 2026-10-12 at 09:00 Pacific in 38 countries. Headline numbers through Friday 2026-10-16: 1.38 million installs, peak daily active users of 412000, day-1 retention of 41.3 percent, crash-free sessions of 99.2 percent, and a store rating of 4.4. Daily active users by day: Mon 268000, Tue 331000, Wed 369000, Thu 412000, Fri 398000. Under "Launch week" tell the story of the week as a short annotated timeline: Monday the login queue peaked at 22000 players at 14:20 and the team added auth capacity; Tuesday hotfix 1.0.1 shipped, fixing a launch crash on Android 12 devices and lifting crash-free sessions from 97.6 to 99.0 percent; Wednesday server capacity was doubled to 120 game servers; Thursday the store featured the game in 14 countries; Friday the first weekend event was announced for 2026-10-17. Under "Open issues" list the open issues in priority order with owner and target date: P1 matchmaking timeouts in Asia-Pacific, Keiko Arai, 2026-10-19; P2 purchase restore failing on some iOS devices, Dan Whitaker, 2026-10-23; P3 leaderboard shows stale ranks after midnight UTC, Samira Boateng, 2026-10-30. Casual tone is fine, it is a game studio.

edit.request: Add Saturday 2026-10-17 to the daily active users with 441000, change the peak to 441000, and mark the P1 matchmaking timeouts issue as resolved on 2026-10-17.
